 - Implemented gradient-based scaling of the problem
 - Least-squares initialization and computation of the duals
 - Support for inertia computation and regularization for KKT linearizations systems

Add type aliasing for scalar data types in unit tests

See `$HIOP_ROOT/tests/LinAlg/testBase.hpp` for:
```cpp
using real_type             = double;
using local_ordinal_type    = int;
using global_ordinal_type   = long long;
```
to make tests more flexible as per my conversation with Slaven. Feedback is appreciated, as it is more than likely that I mistook a global type for a local type (or vice versa) at least once. Most important changes can be found in `$HIOP_ROOT/tests/LinAlg/matrixTests.hpp` and `$HIOP_ROOT/tests/LinAlg/vectorTests.hpp`.

I also considered being more specific with these, eg:
```cpp
using real_type             = double;
using local_ordinal_type    = int32_t; // or uint32_t ? Do we ever rely on local/global indices being <0 ?
using global_ordinal_type   = int64_t; //    uint64_t
```
However I do not know enough about how the types will be used to assume they will never need to be negative. Input on this is welcome.
